prerequisites: Student should has a basic knowledge about the basic mechanical properties of engineering materials; has ordered knowledge about the types of metallic engineering materials - their structure, properties, applications and principles of selection; has detailed knowledge about the structures of steel and cast iron, the principles of classification and labeling; has a basic knowledge about heat and thermo-chemical treatment, has a knowledge about alloy steels and non-ferrous metals and alloys.Has a theoretical knowledge about circuitry.

Can analyze the macroscopic fractures, microstructure of materials, technological defects; is able to determine the characteristics of the microstructure of metallic materials; is able to identify the phases on the basis of equilibrium diagrams; can distinguish between the microstructure in terms of carbon content in steel, the influence of heat treatment; can analyze circuits, can read and interpret the drawings and diagrams used in technical documentation

Has a basic knowledge of the manufacturing processes of products from the liquid metal, the plastic molding, welding and machining techniques. Has a basic knowledge of metrology of geometrical quantities.

learning_outcomes.text: Knows the basic methods of quality assessment of castings and products made by methods of plastic working.
Knows the basic quality assessment methods of products made by prosesses like welding, glueing, screwing and sintered products from metal powders.
Knows the basic quality assessments methods of products manufactured by machining, heat treatement and plastic products.
Can choose the appropriate method for the quality assessment of products manufactured by castings and by methods of plasting working and specify a quality class of product .
Can choose the appropriate method for the quality assessment of products produced in the process of welding and specify a quality class of product .
Can choose the appropriate method for the quality assessment of products manufactured by machining and plastic products and specify a quality class of product .
Searching for the information and critical analysis.
Objective evaluation of arguments to justify, the rational translation and his own point of view using the knowledge about the casting, plastic forming and welding, machining and plastics.
Observance with the customs and rules of the academic environment.

syllabus_topics: Organizational matters. Basic concepts and terminology in systems to ensure product quality.
The techniques used for quality control of products.
Aspects of the application of non-destructive testing for quality control of products.
Geometric measurements of the products.
The methods and principles for quality assessment of the castings.
Methods of quality assessment of rolled, drawn and extruded products.
Methods of quality assessment of forged products
Testing and quality control methods of welded products
Testing and quality control methods of welded and brazed products
Testing and quality control methods of glued and screwed products
Methods of quality assessment of sintered products.
Methods of quality assessment of products after the thermo-chemical treatment.
Methods of quality assessment of plastic products
Methods of quality assessment of products made by machining
Coordinate measuring techniques in the assessment of product quality.
Quality control of non-destructive testing methods.
The study of selected parameters of cast products and the assessment of their quality.
The study of selected parameters of product manufactured by plastic processing technologies and the assessment of their quality.
The study of selected parameters of product manufactured by welding processes and the assessment of their quality.
The study of selected parameters of plastic product and the assessment of their quality.
The study of selected parameters of product manufactured by machining and the assessment of their quality.
Computed tomography in product quality control.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: For the lecture, the concluding grade (P) is equal to the forming grade (F1) from the written-oral exam. For the laboratory, the concluding grade (P) is the average of all grades from oral examinations and short tests.
